subject: Ubuntu version compatible for gpu installation of AMBER 18

messages.author: Jenny 148
messages.body:
Dear all,
We would like to install AMBER18 in our new system. So we would like to
know the ubuntu version which is compatible with the gpu installation of
AMBER 18 and would give better performance. Thank you for any guidance
provided.
Regards,
Jenny

messages.author: aishen
messages.body:
Is there any reason you don't install amber20 ?
For it I use ubuntu 20.10/21.04 (+1 the next coming one)=
